Returns & refunds
You can return items within 30 days of delivery, unworn and with tags attached.
1. Open the order in My orders and choose Return an item.
2. Print the free return label and pack the items.
3. Drop the parcel at any ParcelPoint location. We refund you within 5 working days.

Change the delivery address for the order that hasn't shipped yet.
How do I send something back?

notes: invoice: /account/orders/1043 is the only October order and has 'Download invoice'. #0988 also has 'Download invoice' but is from August; #1077 (November) only offers an order confirmation.
address: /account/addresses can edit addresses too, but says it only affects future orders; the order that hasn't shipped is #1077 and its own form is /account/orders/1077/address.

marketing: the 'Marketing emails: on' toggle is on /account/settings/notifications. Distractors: 'Sign up for our newsletter' on the home page and 'Delete account' on /account/settings (never the way to stop emails).
returns: /help/returns explains the steps. 'Free returns within 30 days' on the home page is plain text, not a link; 'Return an item' on order #1043 also leads to /help/returns.
